purpose: Teach: 腹筋/退治/金髪/トウモロコシ/ねずみ/かぼちゃ/ウイスキー/サウナ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが毎朝腹筋運動なさってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad does his sit-ups every morning, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Warm smile in the voice. A small piece of information offered as a kindness, like sharing something she's noticed about his family.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お家のアリを退治するお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped Mom and Dad get rid of the ants at home!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick attack on the opening. Real pride in a small accomplishment. Seeking her acknowledgment and warmth in return.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお友達は金髪の方なのよ
lines.en: Sho, one of Mei-sis's friends has blonde hair, you know.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Speaking as if thinking aloud, sharing a small detail about her own life with him. Unhurried, gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、給食のトウモロコシ大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love the corn in the school lunch!
lines.style: Enthusiastic but genuine, not performative. A six-year-old's straightforward joy. Soft energy, eager to include her in this small happiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本にかわいいねずみのキャラがいるわね
lines.en: Sho, there's a cute little mouse character in a picture book, isn't there.
lines.style: Quiet, almost dreamy tone. As if she's thinking of something she saw and wanted to tell him about it. Inviting him to imagine it with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとかぼちゃパイ作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made pumpkin pie with Mom!
lines.style: Bright, proud delivery. Soft urgency in wanting to share this with her. A small but significant achievement for a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはウイスキーをたまに召し上がるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has a whisky now and then, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, offhand tone. Like mentioning something she's observed about his father in passing. No judgment, just a small detail shared warmly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお風呂のサウナ入りたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the sauna with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, reaching-toward warmth. A soft request wrapped in excitement. Seeking connection and validation for wanting to spend time with his father.
